beats.say: K/DA has made history as the first K-pop girl group with this record.
According to Wikipedia, their song Pop/Stars was certified platinum by the RIAA in 2022.
This virtual group features four League of Legends characters: Ahri, Akali, Evelynn and Kai'Sa.
But they are more than just a digital band.
Engadget says Logitech released official K/DA gaming gear inspired by their aesthetic.
The collection includes branded versions of the G733 headset, G305 mouse and G840 mousepad.
Who is your favourite member of K/DA?
